framework: ITU-T F.748.44 Assessment criteria for foundation models - Benchmark
requirement_paraphrase: The catalogue summary says the Recommendation covers requirements and evaluation methods of foundation models and gives an overview of benchmarking, aiming at consistency, transparency and comparability.
what_is_tested: Foundation models (benchmark requirements and evaluation methods)

framework: Recommendation of the Council on Artificial Intelligence (OECD/LEGAL/0449), adopted 22 May 2019, amended 8 Nov 2023 and 3 May 2024 as read
clause_or_page: Section I, definition of AI system lifecycle
requirement_paraphrase: The lifecycle definition lists test, evaluate, verify and validate as one of its phases, and says phases are often iterative rather than strictly sequential.

framework: The Bletchley Declaration by Countries Attending the AI Safety Summit, 1-2 November 2023 (gov.uk policy paper, page last updated 13 February 2025)
clause_or_page: Declaration body, paragraph beginning 'We affirm that, whilst safety must be considered across the AI lifecycle' (paragraph position as reported by the fetch summary)
requirement_paraphrase: Actors developing frontier AI capabilities carry a particularly strong responsibility for safety, to be met through measures including safety testing by way of evaluations (wording seen: 'systems for safety testing, through evaluations').
what_is_tested: Safety of frontier AI systems, by evaluation

framework: Draft Framework Convention on artificial intelligence, human rights, democracy and the rule of law, CM(2024)52-prov1 (Ministers' Deputies, 15 March 2024)
requirement_paraphrase: Each Party is called on to enable, as appropriate, controlled environments for developing, experimenting with and testing AI systems under competent authority supervision. Article 3(3) excludes research and development of systems not yet made available, unless testing or similar activity may interfere with human rights, democracy or the rule of law.
what_is_tested: AI systems in controlled test environments
who_tests: Developers under supervision of competent authorities

framework: Good Machine Learning Practice for Medical Device Development: Guiding Principles (Health Canada page, published 27 October 2021, last modified 29 July 2024)
requirement_paraphrase: Clinical benefits and risks should be used to set clinically meaningful performance goals for testing, with attention to global and local performance and input and output variability.

framework: DoD Directive 3000.09, Autonomy in Weapon Systems (reissued 25 January 2023)
requirement_paraphrase: Before formal development a weapon system needs senior approval, and the review must verify that plans for V&V and T&E exist to establish reliability, effectiveness and related properties.
what_is_tested: Existence and adequacy of V&V and T&E plans at the pre-development gate
who_tests: USD(P), USD(R&E) and VCJCS approve; DoD component submits

framework: CFPB Consumer Financial Protection Circular 2022-03 (published 26 May 2022)
requirement_paraphrase: Creditors may use post-hoc explanation methods but, because these approximate models, must still be able to validate the accuracy of the approximations, which may not be possible with less interpretable models.
what_is_tested: Accuracy of post-hoc explanations used for adverse action reasons

framework: Ofcom, Red Teaming for GenAI Harms discussion paper (web page)
requirement_paraphrase: Ofcom describes red teaming as a type of AI model evaluation that attacks a model to see if it produces harmful content so safeguards can be added, and says there is no clear consensus on method, skills or outputs; the page says the paper sets out 10 practices but does not list them.
what_is_tested: Generative AI model vulnerability to harmful output generation
who_tests: AI developers and online services (by description)

framework: Predetermined change control plans for machine learning enabled medical devices: guiding principles (MHRA, FDA, Health Canada; published 24 October 2023)
requirement_paraphrase: A predetermined change control plan should describe the specific planned changes and include methods for verifying and validating them, plus mechanisms to detect failures and revert or halt changes.
what_is_tested: Verification and validation of planned model changes

framework: APRA letter to industry on artificial intelligence (AI), dated April 2026 per page
clause_or_page: Observations for Executive Management, 'AI threats are increasing, but information security practices are struggling to keep pace', expectations list, third bullet
requirement_paraphrase: APRA expects robust security testing across AI generated code, software components and libraries; it observed gaps in the scope and coverage of security testing programmes.
what_is_tested: Security of AI generated code, components and libraries

framework: Guidelines on Ensuring Safety of Automated Driving Vehicles (自動運転車の安全確保に関するガイドライン), 2nd edition, revised 30 September 2025 (original 7 June 2024), MLIT
requirement_paraphrase: Functional safety is to be ensured on the basis of ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF), and a safety evaluation framework based on ISO 35402 is to be applied.
what_is_tested: Functional safety and safety of the intended functionality
who_tests: Vehicle manufacturer or developer (actor not confirmed in the text read)

framework: Regulatory Guidelines for Software Medical Devices: A Life Cycle Approach, GL-04-R2, Revision 2.0, April 2022, HSA
clause_or_page: Section 9.1, AI model selection and dataset, p. 34
requirement_paraphrase: Model evaluation should be done with a test dataset that is separate from the training dataset; the developer should also ensure there is no duplication between training and validation datasets.
what_is_tested: Held out test data for model evaluation

framework: Guidelines for Financial Institutions Adopting Enabling Technologies, issued 15/11/2021, status shown as In-Force on the CBUAE Rulebook page
requirement_paraphrase: Institutions should establish an approved, documented framework to review the reliability, fairness, accuracy and relevance of algorithms, models and data, applied before deployment of a material application and periodically after.
what_is_tested: Reliability, fairness, accuracy and relevance of algorithms, models and data
